Introduction. Deer are passive creatures found in Meadows and Black Forests. They are four-legged, reddish-brown animals that are extremely timid and completely harmless.

Notes. • The most distinguishable way to tell the level of a deer from a distance is by looking at its antlers or lack there of. Antlers or large antlers indicate the deer is starred.
• In an Alpha build of Valheim, the equivalent of a 2-starred deer had antlers and a greenish-blue glow.
